![Hooded Parrot](image/gouldian_finch.jpg)
We are investigating occurrence data of [**Gouldian finch**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gouldian_finch) in Australia from the **Atlas of Living Australia**, and make a map showing the spatial locations of sightings from 2014 to 2024.

```{r echo=FALSE}
# global variables
organism_name <- "gouldian_finch"
organism_title <- "Gouldian finch"
taxa     <- "Gouldian finch"
start    <- 2014
end      <- 2024
```


```{r "request data ALA", eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

organism <- obs_data(taxa, start, end) |> polished_data()
# Save data
mysave(organism_name, organism)
```


This is the head of data set:

```{r "print head of data", echo=FALSE}
organism <- myload(organism_name)
organism |> slice_head(n = 3) |> as_tibble() |> glimpse()
```

Now we want to know the number of occurrence in each state:

```{r "number of occ in state", echo=FALSE}
organism |> my_count(scientificName, obs_state, f=1) |> as_tibble() 
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Clean and prepare data
organism |> plot_map1(color_by = scientificName)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

```


Interpretation:

-    Queensland:\
    77 of your organism records were observed in Queensland.\
    However, only 81 of those were linked to weather stations also located in Queensland.


-   Western Australia:\
    951 observations occurred there,\
    But 989 records were linked to weather stations in Western Australia — suggesting many observations from other states were matched to Western Australia stations.

## 📦 Datasets Overview

The occurrence and weather station data have been processed and organized into the following structured datasets, all stored in the `data/` directory:

### ```r paste0(organism_name, ".rda") ```

Contains raw occurrence records for the target organism across various regions, including key spatial and temporal fields such as latitude, longitude, observation date/time, and administrative boundaries (e.g., state or territory).

### ```r paste0(organism_name, "_ws.rda") ```

An enhanced version of the occurrence dataset in which each record has been spatially matched to its **nearest weather station**. This dataset includes additional metadata fields:

```
- weather_station_id  : ID of the nearest weather station  
- stname              : Weather station name  
- stn_lat, stn_lon    : Coordinates of the weather station  
- stn_state, stn_city : Location details of the station  
```

### ```r paste0(organism_name, "_top_weather.rda") ```

A subset of weather data extracted from the **top N most frequently linked weather stations** in ```r paste0(organism_name, "_ws.rda") ```, used to investigate environmental patterns surrounding the most common observation sites.

### `weather_stations.rda`

A complete reference dataset of unique weather stations, including their identifiers, names, coordinates, and associated administrative metadata. This serves as a lookup or cross-reference for station matching and environmental analysis.
